topic: Recycled plastic raw materials: broom bristles that are kinder to the environment
caption:
A clean broom can care for the environment too. 🌿 At PT Indofilament Global Plastic, our broom and brush bristles are made from nylon filament using recycled plastic raw materials. The result is still strong and consistent, with color options from yellow, green, blue, and pink to our Gold Series, plus diameter, length, and stiffness you can adjust to your needs.

Ideal for broom and brush brands, distributors, and importers who want to offer more eco-friendly products. We also offer custom filament, OEM, and private label.
